6. **P2 — Static endpoints skip uncertain-write normalization.**  
   [runtime.ex:111](/Users/mhostetler/Source/Jido/proj_jido_integration/jido_connect/apps/jido_connect/lib/jido_connect/mcp/runtime.ex:111)

   The static endpoint path returns the client error directly. An unknown send result returned `reason: :outcome_unknown` and `mutation?: false`. The managed path returns the documented `:mcp_write_uncertain` and `mutation?: true`. Delivery remains `:sent_outcome_unknown`, but hosts receive inconsistent write classification.

   **Correction:** Use one write-result classifier for static and managed endpoints. The existing uncertain-write test covers only managed endpoints.

Acceptance: Reproduce the reported case against current source, apply the smallest correction described above, and add focused verification of both the failing case and supported behavior. For documentation/design work, update the public contract and verify its examples/callers. Preserve tenant, scope, lease, and host ownership boundaries. Use fresh matching v3 dependencies for final verification; saved local v2 build artifacts do not establish v3 conformance.

Do not modify jido_mcp or publish packages. Full source review and its coverage/verification limits are preserved in the parent epic comments.

comments.text: Fixed in d855a3c4. Static and managed MCP writes share uncertain-result classification; focused MCP tests pass. Full umbrella mix quality and demo format, warnings-as-errors compile, and 21 demo tests pass.
